items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: they had to look for other bass players and they fooled around and took this one and that one until finally they landed on Pettiford... And did Wendell Marshall follow Oscar Pettiford into the band

ctx.x: Trumpet. He was a trumpet player, yeah. He was a trumpet player. The cousin I was speaking of was Oscar Over. He used to be a judge up here in the central part of California in one of the little courts up there somewhere.
And he had retired and became a landscape gardener.
